content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can set up a sovereign digital commerce stack that enables you to accept payments in cryptocurrencies. By utilizing platforms like NOWPayments, you can easily integrate crypto payment processing for over 300 currencies, enabling instant transactions and automatic payment confirmations. This infrastructure operates around the clock, ensuring you can sell your digital products to an international audience without the constraints of traditional payment processors. Start designing your online store today and remove the barriers that have held you back.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

To create a functioning online store, consider deploying the Sovereign Starter Stack. For $97, this solution includes GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend operations, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. With three products loaded and a 30-day support window, you can get everything operational in just 48 hours. This stack is designed for creators who want to maintain full ownership and control of their digital products without ongoing fees or subscriptions. Your infrastructure sovereignty begins here.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus your efforts on deploying the core components of your online store rather than getting bogged down in unnecessary details. You do not need to worry about complex integrations or high-cost setups. Instead, prioritize establishing your payment processing and product hosting solutions first. Infrastructure sovereignty is about making strategic choices that empower you. Once you have a working stack, you can refine and expand your offerings as needed.
Crypto payments eliminate traditional banking barriers.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Once your online store is set up, it's time to make your first sale. Promote your digital products through social media channels or relevant online communities. Ensure your crypto payment options are clearly communicated, emphasizing the speed and low fees of transactions like USDT on the Tron network, which settles in under 60 seconds for less than $0.10. With NOWPayments handling the payment processing, you can focus on engaging with your audience and driving sales.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, take decisive action. Start by purchasing the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Complete Builder Kit for comprehensive resources and templates. Set up your GitHub Pages hosting and integrate Google Apps Script for backend functionality. Load your first three digital products and connect with NOWPayments for seamless crypto payment processing. Commit to daily growth by promoting your store and refining your product offerings.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Get paid instantly without waiting days for transactions.

For further support, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) that includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates necessary for a comprehensive digital commerce setup. This kit empowers you to effectively build, deploy, and scale your online store. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
